@graph.headline: How Much Does LLM Optimization Cost for Small Businesses?
@graph.description: LLM optimization costs small businesses $29-$5,000 per month in 2026. Real prices for DIY tools, freelancers, AI-assisted providers and agencies.

mainEntity.name: How much does LLM optimization cost per month?

acceptedAnswer.text: Between $29 and $5,000 per month for small businesses as of August 2026. Self-serve tracking tools cost $29-$250, freelancers $500-$2,000, AI-assisted providers around $800-$999, and agency retainers $1,500-$5,000. Most small businesses spend $1,000-$2,500 monthly.

mainEntity.name: What is the cheapest way to start LLM optimization?

acceptedAnswer.text: Free. Add FAQ schema markup to your site, restructure key pages so each answers one question directly, complete your Google Business Profile, and collect customer reviews. When you want measurement, Otterly AI starts at $29 per month for 15 prompts across four engines.

mainEntity.name: Do I need to pay for LLM optimization if I already pay for SEO?

acceptedAnswer.text: Often not separately. Schema markup, FAQ content, structured headings and citation building are standard modern SEO deliverables. Ask your current provider which of the five retainer components they already cover, and only buy the genuine gap. Paying two providers for the same schema work is common.

mainEntity.name: How much does a one-time LLM optimization audit cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: $800 to $2,500 for a small business, based on published 2026 AEO pricing. An audit tells you which prompts surface competitors instead of you and what is blocking citation. It is a reasonable first purchase, though it produces a plan rather than results.

mainEntity.name: How long until my business appears in ChatGPT answers?

acceptedAnswer.text: Typically 3 to 6 months, with early signals at 4 to 8 weeks. Large language models need roughly 60 to 90 days to recrawl and shift citations, so no provider can honestly promise faster. Less contested local and niche queries move soonest.

mainEntity.name: Why do LLM optimization quotes vary so much?

acceptedAnswer.text: Five factors: how many AI engines are tracked, how many prompts, how much content is produced monthly, your site's technical starting condition, and how many geographic markets. A quote covering 20 prompts on three engines is not comparable to one covering 200 prompts on seven, even though both are called the same thing.

mainEntity.name: Can I do LLM optimization myself?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, for the fundamentals. Schema markup, question-structured content, a complete Business Profile and review generation are all achievable in-house and cost only time. Sustained content production and off-site citation building are where most owners run out of hours and outsourcing starts to pay.
